name: British Museum
type: museum; art museum; charitable organization; non-departmental public body; national museum
text: The British Museum is a public museum dedicated to human history, art and culture located in the Bloomsbury area of London. Its permanent collection of eight million artefacts is the largest in the world. It documents the story of human culture from its beginnings to the present.

depictions.name: The British Museum
depictions.text: The British Museum is a unique building in Empire: Total War. It may only be constructed by Great Britain. It must be constructed in their capital region.
